context: Hiroshi-boss gives Yuki formal year-end remarks.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: business keigo; ceremonial vocabulary (申し上げ/につきまして/年度/施設/団体/保険) in natural home.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 本年度の御協力に、御礼申し上げます。
lines.en: I thank you for your cooperation this fiscal year.
lines.style: formal boss voice, soft warm composed dignified clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新年度につきまして、計画はございますか?
lines.en: Do you have plans regarding the new fiscal year?
lines.style: polite office woman voice, soft warm respectful clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新しい施設を、設ける予定だ。
lines.en: We plan to establish a new facility.
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm composed clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 施設の保険につきましては、確認します。
lines.en: I'll check on the facility's insurance.
lines.style: reliable office woman voice, soft warm professional clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 関係する団体にも、連絡を頼む。
lines.en: Please contact the related organizations too.
lines.style: formal boss voice, soft warm composed clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 保険の手続きも、年度内に進めます。
lines.en: I'll advance the insurance procedures within the year.
lines.style: diligent office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 団体との連携につきまして、感謝申し上げる。
lines.en: I'm grateful regarding the ties with the organizations.
lines.style: warm boss voice, soft warm dignified clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 来年度も、誠心誠意努めて参ります。
lines.en: I'll devote myself sincerely next year too.
lines.style: earnest office woman voice, soft warm sincere closing throughout
